subject: FinOpsify renewal & SOW — pricing and redlines
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finopsify.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: FinOpsify renewal & SOW - initial ask

Hi Elena,

We're coming up on our FinOpsify renewal (current term ends 2025-12-15) and I wanted to get a renewal quote and an updated SOW to circulate internally. Current usage: 20 analyst seats (prod + staging), auto-ingest for AWS and GCP billing, and the cost-analyzer agent deployed to our prod accounts.

Can you send: 1) a clean renewal quote for 1yr and 2yr terms with list pricing and a line for agent licensing; 2) an editable SOW we can redline; 3) any changes to data residency or contract language since last year (we may need to confirm EU residency for one team).

High level asks from our side: a) prefer net-30 payment terms, b) SLA credits for >99.5% data ingestion availability, and c) confirmation that KV cache / telemetry data does not include customer PII.

Looping in Vivek (finance) and Grace (legal) to expedite review. Our HubSpot deal id is HB-2025-5421 if you want to attach notes.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none
From: Elena Morales <elena@finopsify.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: FinOpsify Renewals <renewals@finopsify.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FinOpsify renewal & SOW - initial ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the details and the heads up — happy to get this moving. Attached is a starter quote (FinOpsify_Quote_2025-11-02.pdf) and an SOW template. Summary here:

- 1-year: $95,000/year (20 seats + standard agent). 10% annual discount applied for existing customer.
- 2-year: $179,000 (5% additional term discount applied).
- Data residency: US by default; EU residency is supported as an add-on (estimated +$8k/year) — that requires a short provisioning lead time.

I've also attached the standard SOW as a Word doc (editable). I can push an updated DocuSign when you confirm which term you prefer and any redlines that legal wants.

DocuSign turnaround time is typically 24-48 hours once we have final SOW.

Best,
Elena Morales
Enterprise Renewals Manager, FinOpsify

--
Attachment: FinOpsify_Quote_2025-11-02.pdf; SOW_Template_2025.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-11-03T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: RE: FinOpsify renewal & SOW - internal review

Karthik / Grace — quick take after looking at the vendor quote and our usage:

- The 1yr $95k number is acceptable as a starting point, but push for a better discount given committed usage and our reserved compute purchasing cadence. Target 12-15% off list for 1yr, or buy down to $85k effective.
- If EU residency is required only for a single team, ask for a scoped add-on rather than org-wide charge.
- Payment terms: insist on net-30 (they offered standard invoice cadence); add PO/early pay discount language if they push net-60.
- SOW redlines attached — see SOW_Redline_karthik_2025-11-03.docx (I added liability cap language and adjusted SLA credits to 5% of monthly fee per outage instance).

If they come back with DocuSign that matches our redlines and the price is <=$90k for 1yr, I can sign from Finance for commitment.

Vivek
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: SOW_Redline_karthik_2025-11-03.docx
From: Elena Morales <elena@finopsify.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: FinOpsify Renewals <renewals@finopsify.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FinOpsify renewal & SOW - updated quote

Hi Vivek / Karthik,

Appreciate the clear notes — attached is an updated quote reflecting a 12% renewal discount for a 1-year term (FinOpsify_Quote_2025-11-02.pdf — updated). We accepted the revised SLA credit language in the SOW and adjusted the liability cap to align with your redline. EU residency will be scoped as a per-team add-on; I've added a line item and noted provisioning lead time.

If that looks good, here's the DocuSign link to review and sign: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/abc123

Please confirm: 1) term = 1 year, 2) billing contact and PO (if required). Once signed we can schedule the kickoff (2-week onboarding, want to propose week of 2025-11-17).

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Enterprise Renewals Manager, FinOpsify

--
Attachment: FinOpsify_Quote_2025-11-02.pdf; DocuSign_Link.txt
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finopsify.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-11-04T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FinOpsify renewal & SOW - approval and next steps

Elena — thanks and appreciate the quick turn. Vivek and I reviewed the updated quote and signed terms are good for Finance. Confirming:

- Term: 1 year
- Effective annual fee: $83,600 (12% discount applied)
- EU residency scoped for one team as an add-on (we'll confirm details in onboarding)
- Payment: net-30, PO on file (will route after DocuSign)

Please send the DocuSign envelope (link above looks correct) and we will complete signature from our side today. Once signed, please schedule the onboarding kickoff for the week of 2025-11-17 (Dylan will be our engineering lead on the project).

Grace — legal, please hold on counter-signing notes if anything unusual pops in the final envelope, otherwise we're good to proceed.

Elena — copying renewals contact for visibility.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
